card.name: Footnote symbols and digits in numbers
card.fires_on: Footnote and dagger marks after drug names or table values, broken-up special characters, and a single digit (often 9) inside a year or reference number.

modes.label: Footnote marks
modes.description: Dagger-type or broken symbol characters that mark footnotes after names, doses or list items.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a year, citation number or table value.

card.plain: It fires on footnote symbols and on single digits inside numbers like years and reference numbers.
